name: rate-approval
title: Rate approval working paper
for_each: select id,code from properties order by code

sections.title: Proposed nightly totals
sections.sql: select name,stay_date,min_stay,proposed_cents,nightly_fee_cents,total_cents,currency,readiness from rate_plan where property_id=$1 and stay_date>=current_date order by stay_date,name

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select l.name,d.stay_date,a.rate_cents,a.total_cents,a.min_stay,a.actor,a.reason,a.created_at from decisions a join rate_days d on d.id=a.rate_day_id join listings l on l.id=d.listing_id where l.property_id=$1 order by a.created_at desc
sections.note: Historical decisions. Use the approved-plan command to check that a decision still matches current evidence before copying prices elsewhere.

name: revenue-meeting
title: Weekly revenue meeting pack
for_each: select id,code from properties order by code

sections.title: Booking movement
sections.sql: select name,stay_date,observed_on,sold,pickup_rooms,adr_cents,revpar_cents,currency from pickup where property_id=$1 order by stay_date,name

sections.title: Events
sections.sql: select name,starts_on,ends_on,uplift_bps,evidence from events where property_id=$1 order by starts_on

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,resolution from tasks where property_id=$1 order by due_on
